fieldData.acrm---key-feature-2-content:
Business cards read into the right fields

Photograph a card on the tablet and the app reads the name, title, company, and email into the form. Any field it cannot read clearly goes back to the staffer to type in by hand.
fieldData.afb---prompt: Build a trade show lead form template my booth staff fill out on a tablet, with a hot, warm, or cold rating for each visitor.
